snapshot: WHO Western Pacific Region. 2026 is the implementation year of the government's MADANI health reform, built around digitalisation, financing reform, workforce and public health. Malaysia chairs the ASEAN health ministers' track this year.

agenda.title: Four leaps of health reform
agenda.text: The ministry named four leaps for 2026: comprehensive digitalisation, financing reform, human capital and welfare, and public health and ethics. Targets include a total hospital information system in 16 hospitals, a cloud-based clinic system in 2,489 primary care facilities, and permanent posts for 4,500 medical officers and 935 nurses.

agenda.title: Financing reform and MediAsas
agenda.text: On financing, the minister said in July 2026 that MediAsas is meant to complement, not replace, the public healthcare system.

agenda.title: From advocacy to implementation in global health
agenda.text: At the 79th World Health Assembly Dzulkefly said Malaysia is shifting from advocacy to implementation. Bilateral cooperation includes genomics with Indonesia and regional health security with Singapore, Vietnam and Bangladesh; Malaysia also pushes ASEAN pooled procurement and sponsored the integrated lung health resolution. It chairs the 2026 ASEAN Health Ministers' Meeting in Kuala Lumpur.
